items.title: Lincoln Property to repurpose north Houston eyesore Greenspoint Mall into industrial park
items.summary: Kevin Wyatt, executive vice president at Lincoln Property Company, with 555 Seminar Drive in Houston (Getty, Lincoln Property Company, Google Maps)Lincoln Property Company is stepping up to redevelop the Houston-area Greenspoint Mall at 555 Seminar Drive. Dallas-based Lincoln snapped up all the parcels that make up the 80-acre mall property and plans to redevelop the site into a 1.2 million-square-foot industrial development. items.title: ExxonMobil (XOM) Delivers Record Oil Output And Revenue On Lower Spending
items.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings (NYSE:XOM) recently reported record oil output and revenue achieved while keeping capital spending at lower levels. Management highlighted higher production from high-return assets such as the Permian Basin as a key driver of these records. The group indicated that technology and efficiency gains allowed it to sustain operations despite geopolitical risks affecting Middle East supply routes.
